items.title: 德銀示警美股科技股還沒跌完！距長期趨勢底部還有5%
items.title_en: Deutsche Bank Warns US Tech Stocks Still Have About 5% More Downside to Long‑Term Trend Bottom
paras: 在德意志銀行下調美股科技股及大型成長股評級後，科技股與標普500指數其他成分股的表現迅速分化。該行最新分析指出，科技股相對標普500指數其餘成分股的表現，距離長期趨勢通道底部仍有約5%的下跌空間。
此前報導指出，德銀多資產策略團隊於10月9日將美股科技股及大型成長股（MCG & Tech）評級從「加碼」下調至「中性」，理由是板塊風險與報酬已嚴重失衡。此後兩週，科技股下跌約7%，標普500指數其餘成分股則上漲約5%，兩者表現相差12個百分點。
儘管科技股已明顯回檔，德銀追蹤的機構持倉指標顯示，投資人對科技股的配置尚未降至極端低檔。
過去兩週，科技基金仍吸引約300億美元資金流入，反映部分投資人持續逢低買進，但最新交易日已轉為資金淨流出。
德銀認為，若未出現關稅衝擊或地緣政治衝突等重大外部事件，這波修正更可能是資金從科技股轉向其他板塊，而非演變成美股全面性下跌。
科技股能否在趨勢通道底部附近止穩，將取決於企業財報能否支撐獲利預期，以及資金流出是否持續。

科技股相對表現仍有約5個百分點修正空間

德銀追蹤的數據顯示，科技股相對標普500指數其餘成分股的表現，已落入長期趨勢通道下半部，但距離通道底部仍有約5個百分點的空間。過去，這一區域曾多次成為科技股相對表現反轉的起點。
在過去五輪板塊輪動中，科技股曾有兩次短暫跌破趨勢通道下軌，分別發生於關稅衝擊及美伊衝突期間。
德銀認為，若本輪調整沒有遭遇類似規模的外部衝擊，科技股相對表現較可能在通道底部附近企穩，而非進一步演變為系統性下跌。
不過，歷史走勢並不保證本輪修正一定止步於此，若外部風險升高，科技股仍可能跌破通道下軌。

科技股持倉降溫　300億美元逢低買盤面臨考驗

德銀數據顯示，科技股機構持倉已從10月初接近歷史高位的第85百分位，降至目前的第33百分位，接近美伊衝突期間的低點。
整體股票持倉降至第41百分位，主動型投資人的持倉更降至第18百分位，創一個多月來新低；系統性策略持倉則仍處於第79百分位。小型股配置更加保守，持倉降至第12百分位，為2023年4月以來最大低配幅度。
另一方面，過去兩週科技基金淨流入約300億美元，其中約120億美元流入槓桿型ETF。然而，週四科技股再度下跌時，當日資金流向已轉為淨流出約15億美元。
這顯示，逢低買進仍是近期市場的重要資金動向，但投資人信心並不穩固。若資金持續撤出，科技股修正時間可能拉長；反之，若市場情緒回暖，資金回流也可能加速反彈。

財報季成關鍵考驗　長期獲利預期左右反彈空間

德銀認為，財報表現將是判斷科技股能否止穩的重要依據。過去科技股曾兩度在觸及長期趨勢通道底部附近後反彈，分別發生於去年7月底及今年4月，兩次都伴隨財報季期間的強勁業績。
目前市場主要擔憂的是中長期獲利成長，而非近期業績表現。德銀估算，從目前科技股持倉所隱含的預期來看，市場對獲利成長的預期約為10%，明顯低於市場對第三季獲利年增約65%的預測。
若企業財報符合預期，科技股可能迎來反彈機會；但若業績未能消除市場對長期成長前景的疑慮，即使短期獲利強勁，也未必足以扭轉股價走勢。
此外，下週的聯準會利率決策會議，以及隨後登場的美國期中選舉，也可能影響市場風險偏好與資金配置。

歐洲股市及非科技板塊迎轉機　德銀維持標普500目標價

科技股配置降溫，也為其他產業及市場創造資金輪動空間。
德銀數據顯示，金融股持倉處於第20百分位、原材料股第25百分位、民生必需品股第15百分位、景氣循環型工業股第27百分位，均處於相對低檔。能源股則是例外，持倉達第81百分位。
地區配置方面，歐洲股市的科技股占比約9%，遠低於美股的約40%。因此，當科技股相對表現轉弱時，歐洲市場可能展現相對優勢。
儘管下調科技股評級，德銀仍維持標普500指數2026年目標價8,000點，並預估2026年及2027年每股盈餘分別為358美元及420美元。
該行強調，此次調降評級針對的是短期風險報酬，並未改變對科技股長期成長前景的看法。過去10年，科技股相較標普500指數其餘成分股的年化超額報酬約為14個百分點，較強的獲利成長仍是支撐科技股長期跑贏大盤的主要因素。
整體而言，德銀並未認為科技股的長期成長趨勢已經逆轉，而是提醒短期相對表現仍有修正空間。接下來，企業財報能否支撐獲利預期、資金流向是否持續惡化，以及外部風險是否升高，將決定這波板塊輪動能否在長期趨勢通道底部附近止穩。
paras_en: After Deutsche Bank cut its ratings on US tech and large‑cap growth stocks, the performance of tech stocks diverged sharply from the rest of the S&P 500 constituents. The bank’s latest analysis says that relative to the other S&P 500 components, tech stocks still have roughly a 5% decline left before reaching the bottom of the long‑term trend channel.

Earlier reports noted that Deutsche Bank’s multi‑asset strategy team on October 9 downgraded US tech and large‑cap growth stocks (MCG & Tech) from “overweight” to “neutral,” citing a severe imbalance between sector risk and reward. In the two weeks that followed, tech stocks fell about 7% while the rest of the S&P 500 rose roughly 5%, a 12‑percentage‑point spread.
Even though tech stocks have pulled back noticeably, Deutsche Bank’s institutional‑positioning indicator shows investors have not yet reduced their tech allocations to an extreme low.
In the past two weeks, tech funds still attracted about $30 billion of inflows, reflecting that some investors kept buying on dips, but the latest trading day saw a net outflow instead.

Deutsche Bank believes that, absent a major external shock such as a tariff impact or geopolitical conflict, this correction is more likely a rotation of money out of tech into other sectors rather than the start of a broad US market decline.
Whether tech can stabilize near the bottom of the trend channel will depend on whether corporate earnings can support profit expectations and whether outflows continue.

Tech’s relative performance still has about a 5‑percentage‑point correction space. Deutsche Bank’s data show that tech’s relative performance versus the rest of the S&P 500 has entered the lower half of the long‑term trend channel, but there remains roughly a 5‑percentage‑point gap to the channel bottom. Historically, this zone has often been the starting point for a reversal in tech’s relative performance.
In the last five sector‑rotation cycles, tech briefly broke below the lower trend‑channel line twice, once during a tariff shock and once during the US‑Iran conflict.

Deutsche Bank thinks that if this round of adjustment does not encounter a similarly sized external shock, tech’s relative performance is more likely to stabilize near the channel bottom rather than turn into a systemic decline.
However, history does not guarantee the correction will stop here; if external risks rise, tech could still break below the lower channel line.

Tech holdings have cooled – $30 billion of dip‑buying now faces a test. Deutsche Bank data show institutional tech positions have fallen from the 85th percentile near a historic high in early October to the 33rd percentile, close to the low seen during the US‑Iran conflict.

Overall equity holdings have slipped to the 41st percentile, active‑manager holdings to the 18th percentile – a one‑month low – while systematic‑strategy holdings remain at the 79th percentile. Small‑cap allocations are even more conservative, now at the 12th percentile, the deepest underweight since April 2023.

On the other hand, over the past two weeks tech funds saw a net inflow of about $30 billion, including roughly $12 billion into leveraged ETFs. Yet when tech stocks fell again on Thursday, that day’s cash flow turned into a net outflow of about $1.5 billion.

This shows that dip‑buying is still a notable recent market driver, but investor confidence is fragile. If money keeps withdrawing, the tech correction could lengthen; conversely, a sentiment rebound could accelerate a bounce back as capital returns.

Earnings season is a key test – long‑term profit expectations will shape the rebound potential. Deutsche Bank notes that tech has rebounded twice after touching near the long‑term trend‑channel bottom, once in late July last year and again in April this year, both times coinciding with strong earnings periods.

The market’s current worry is about mid‑ to long‑term profit growth rather than near‑term results. Deutsche Bank estimates that, based on current tech positioning, the market’s profit‑growth expectation is about 10%, well below the roughly 65% year‑over‑year earnings growth forecast for Q3.

If corporate earnings meet expectations, tech could see a bounce; but if results fail to allay concerns about long‑term growth prospects, even strong short‑term earnings may not reverse the price trend.
In addition, next week’s Fed rate decision and the upcoming US midterm elections could affect market risk appetite and capital allocation.
European equities and non‑tech sectors see a turnaround – Deutsche Bank keeps its S&P 500 target price.

Deutsche Bank data show financials at the 20th percentile, materials at the 25th, consumer staples at the 15th, cyclical industrials at the 27th – all relatively low. Energy is the exception, with holdings at the 81st percentile.
Regionally, tech makes up about 9% of European equity exposure, far below the roughly 40% in US equities. Thus, when tech underperforms, European markets may show relative strength.
Despite the tech rating downgrade, Deutsche Bank maintains a 2026 S&P 500 target of 8,000 points and forecasts EPS of $358 for 2026 and $420 for 2027.

The bank stresses that the downgrade concerns short‑term risk‑reward and does not change its long‑term outlook for tech. Over the past decade, tech has delivered about a 14‑percentage‑point annualized excess return over the rest of the S&P 500, with strong profit growth remaining the main driver of its outperformance.

Overall, Deutsche Bank does not see a reversal of tech’s long‑term growth trend, but warns that short‑term relative performance still has correction space. Going forward, whether earnings can support profit expectations, whether cash flows continue to deteriorate, and whether external risks rise will determine if this sector rotation can stabilize near the long‑term trend‑channel bottom.

items.title: AI跌倒、美債吃飽？全球資金爭奪戰 市場用錢投票
items.title_en: AI Stumbles, US Treasuries Satiated? Global Capital Battle Shows Markets Voting with Money
paras: 科技巨頭龐大AI支出引發回報疑慮，AI相關股票單週重挫4.9%，美債則迎來避險買盤，10年期殖利率跌破5%。當AI擴張與政府赤字融資爭搶有限資本，資金轉向債市，正挑戰廉價資本長存的市場假設。
過去兩年，做多大型科技股、做空防禦性資產，幾乎是華爾街最穩固的共識，如今卻面臨挑戰。投資人關注的核心問題是，科技巨頭投入AI的龐大資金，能否在足夠短的時間內帶來相應回報。
AI支出膨脹 投資人開始算帳
Anthropic未來數年可能為額外算力耗資7,500億美元；Meta執行長祖克柏則宣布，公司未來算力與AI基礎設施租約及合約支出約達8,250億美元。
Meta股價本週大跌逾9%，創5月以來最大單週跌幅，信用風險指標同步攀至歷史高點。其他超大規模雲端業者與晶片製造商的債務違約保護成本也跟著上升。
壓力並不限於科技業，全球企業債信用利差普遍擴大。衡量美國企業債信用風險的CDX投資等級指數，週五盤中最高升至64.4，創3月以來最高盤中水準，反映投資人對信用風險的擔憂加深。
科技股失速 美債重拾避險功能
與AI股走弱形成對比，美債迎來避險買盤。Neuberger Berman多資產共同投資長Jeffrey Blazek形容，市場出現徹底反轉，資金爭相湧入公債，與AI交易走勢分歧。
本週一，大量投資等級債券供給一度推升10年期美債殖利率至5.14%，隨後對AI投資的疑慮帶動資金轉向債市。週四，美債殖利率全面下滑12至18個基點，以中天期債券表現最突出，債市創逾一年來最佳單日表現。
10年期美債殖利率當日收在4.97%，為一個月來首次收盤跌破5%，也是6月以來首次跌破50日均線。長天期債券ETF則連續三週上漲。
AI相關股票組合與10年期美債殖利率已連續九週同向波動，為ChatGPT問世以來最長紀錄。這意味著AI股走弱時，美債殖利率也跟著下滑、價格上漲，與7月AI交易降溫、美債同樣承壓的情況不同。
野村策略師Charlie McElligott指出，債券正重新發揮避險功能。NewEdge Wealth投資長Cameron Dawson也認為，先前領漲類股轉趨防禦，加上信用指數釋出壓力訊號，讓投資人有理由尋求債券的相對安全性。
債券ETF吸金 防禦配置升溫
資金流向也印證這項轉變。本月債券ETF流入約580億美元，占整體ETF資金流入的38%。據Baird Strategas，股票與固定收益ETF的需求差距，已降至歷史最低的一成區間。
彭博數據顯示，固定收益產品連續第二個月吸引超過35%的整體ETF流入資金，為去年初以來首見。
彭博智庫分析師Athanasios Psarofagis表示，過去兩個月債券資金流入明顯高於平常，部分反映投資人轉向防禦配置，同時也受到殖利率吸引，希望趁機鎖定收益。
AI與政府融資 爭搶同一筆錢
市場波動背後，是AI資本支出與政府赤字融資同時擴張。企業需要資金興建資料中心、購買算力，政府則須融資支付福利、利息與國防開銷，兩者正向同一個債券市場爭取資金。
若儲蓄供給未同步增加，資本成本便面臨上升壓力。金融危機後，政府財政、科技企業擴張與資產估值，長期建立在廉價資本將持續存在的假設上，如今這項假設正受到挑戰。
產業長期前景與短期融資壓力可以並存。鐵路革命改變美國，但19世紀鐵路債務也引發多輪金融危機；網路重塑世界，仍未阻止2000年前後的資本泡沫破裂。
弱信用債承壓 廉價資本邏輯動搖
信用利差擴大，已成為資金壓力的早期訊號。本週，再融資疑慮推升CCC級債券殖利率至15.85%，創2020年以來最高；與整體非投資等級債券的殖利率差距達7.48個百分點，但仍較2016年與2020年的高峰低約1個百分點。
若低信用評級債券持續承壓，代表資金緊縮正向融資能力較弱的企業與資產傳導，並可能進一步影響就業、消費與實體投資。
AI具備價值，不代表任何價格的AI投資都合理；政府能發債，也不代表債務可以無限擴張而不付出代價。這波資金轉向美債，反映市場重新重視資本的稀缺性，並要求投資回報與融資風險獲得更合理的定價。
paras_en: Tech giants' massive AI spending has raised return doubts, with AI‑related stocks tumbling 4.9% over the week while US Treasuries attracted safe‑haven buying and the 10‑year yield slipped below 5%. As AI expansion and government deficit financing vie for limited capital, funds are shifting to bonds, challenging the market assumption of ever‑cheap capital.

For the past two years, the most solid Wall Street consensus was to go long large‑cap tech and short defensive assets; that view is now under pressure. Investors are focused on whether the huge AI outlays by tech giants can generate commensurate returns in a reasonably short time frame.
AI spending balloons – investors start doing the math

Anthropic could spend $750 billion on extra compute over the next few years; Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said the company’s future compute and AI‑infrastructure lease and contract costs will total about $825 billion.

Meta’s stock fell more than 9% this week, its biggest weekly drop since May, and its credit‑risk metrics rose to historic highs. Debt‑protection costs for other mega‑cloud providers and chip makers also climbed.

The pressure isn’t limited to tech; corporate‑bond credit spreads are widening globally. The CDX investment‑grade index, a gauge of US corporate credit risk, rose intraday on Friday to a peak of 64.4, the highest level since March, reflecting growing investor concern over credit risk.
Tech stocks lose momentum, US Treasuries regain safe‑haven role

In contrast to the weakening AI stocks, US Treasuries saw a wave of safe‑haven buying. Jeffrey Blazek, co‑head of multi‑asset investments at Neuberger Berman, described the market as undergoing a complete reversal, with capital rushing into sovereign bonds while diverging from AI trades.

On Monday, a flood of investment‑grade bond supply briefly pushed the 10‑year Treasury yield up to 5.14%, but doubts about AI investments soon drove funds back to bonds. By Thursday, Treasury yields fell 12‑18 basis points across the curve, with mid‑term bonds posting the strongest gains and the bond market delivering its best single‑day performance in over a year.

The 10‑year Treasury closed at 4.97% that day, the first time in a month it closed below 5% and the first breach of the 50‑day moving average since June. Long‑term bond ETFs have risen for three consecutive weeks.

AI‑related stock portfolios and the 10‑year Treasury yield have moved in the same direction for nine straight weeks – the longest streak since ChatGPT launched. This means that when AI stocks weaken, Treasury yields also fall (prices rise), a pattern different from July when both AI equities and Treasuries were under pressure.

Nomura strategist Charlie McElligott noted that bonds are re‑asserting their safe‑haven function. Cameron Dawson, CIO of NewEdge Wealth, added that the shift from growth‑lead stocks to defensive positioning, together with credit‑index stress signals, gives investors reason to seek the relative safety of bonds.
Bond ETFs attract inflows, defensive allocations heat up

Fund flows confirm the shift. This month, bond ETFs saw about $58 billion of net inflows, accounting for 38% of total ETF inflows. According to Baird Strategas, the demand gap between equity and fixed‑income ETFs has narrowed to a historic low of roughly 10%.
Bloomberg data show that fixed‑income products have attracted more than 35% of total ETF inflows for the second consecutive month, a first since early 2023.

Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Athanasios Psarofagis said that bond inflows over the past two months have been markedly above average, reflecting investors moving toward defensive allocations and being drawn by yields as they try to lock in returns.
AI and government financing compete for the same money

Behind the market volatility is the simultaneous expansion of AI capital spending and government deficit financing. Companies need cash to build data centers and buy compute power, while governments must raise funds for welfare, interest payments and defense, both tapping the same bond market for capital.

If savings supply does not keep pace, capital costs face upward pressure. Since the financial crisis, government budgets, tech‑company expansion and asset valuations have long rested on the assumption that cheap capital will persist; that premise is now being challenged.

Long‑term industry outlook and short‑term financing pressure can coexist. The railroad revolution reshaped the United States, yet 19th‑century railroad debt sparked multiple financial crises; the internet reshaped the world but did not prevent the early‑2000s capital bubble burst.
Weak‑credit bonds under pressure, cheap‑capital logic shaken

Widening credit spreads have become an early signal of funding stress. This week, refinancing concerns lifted CCC‑rated bond yields to 15.85%, the highest since 2020, a 7.48‑percentage‑point spread over overall non‑investment‑grade bonds, though still about one point below the peaks of 2016 and 2020.

If low‑rated bonds remain under pressure, it indicates that tightening funds are flowing to companies and assets with weaker financing capacity, potentially affecting employment, consumption and real‑economy investment.

AI may have value, but not every AI investment is priced reasonably; governments can issue debt, but that doesn’t mean debt can expand indefinitely without cost. This shift of capital into US Treasuries reflects a market re‑recognition of capital scarcity and a demand for more appropriate pricing of investment returns and financing risk.

items.title: Fed 12月升息添變數！高盛示警美債殖利率風險：AI交易反轉、能源通膨升溫
items.title_en: Fed December Rate Hike Uncertain as Goldman Sachs Warns of US Treasury Yield Risks: AI Trading Reversal, Energy Inflation Heating Up
paras: 美國公債殖利率近期自高點快速回落，人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮與能源價格衝擊這兩股推升利率的力量，正呈現不同走向。高盛指出，隨著AI股票遭遇賣壓，資金重新流向長天期美債，但AI投資帶來的融資需求與能源價格引發的通膨風險仍未消退，使聯準會（Fed）12月是否升息充滿不確定性。
上週四（22日），美國10年期公債殖利率單日下跌17個基點，創2023年3月以來最大單日跌幅，並重新跌破5%關卡。
高盛固定收益、貨幣與大宗商品部門策略師 Cosimo Codacci-Pisanelli 在最新報告中指出，先前推升殖利率的AI交易，如今反而成為殖利率回落的原因之一。
隨著AI股票遭到拋售，投資人轉向長天期美債避險，股債相關性也隨之逆轉，債券重新成為股票投資組合的避險工具。
不過，這並不代表美債殖利率的上行風險已經解除。AI業者持續擴大資本支出、增加債務融資，加上能源價格與通膨走勢仍不明朗，都可能影響美債供需及聯準會的利率決策。
高盛仍預期聯準會12月升息，但認為市場難以重新完全反映升息25個基點的預期。隨著AI成長前景、能源價格與美債供需關係持續變化，投資人除了須留意經濟成長放緩的風險，也不能忽視通膨居高不下可能促使聯準會維持緊縮政策的壓力。

AI交易反轉　美債重新吸引避險資金

Codacci-Pisanelli將近期美債殖利率下跌歸納為三項因素：高利率開始壓抑AI相關資產表現、AI帶動的經濟成長大幅放緩的尾端風險升高，以及股債相關性改變，使長天期美債重新發揮對沖股票風險的作用。
這與本月稍早美國通膨數據偏熱、股債同步下跌的市場情況形成對比。野村證券策略師 Charlie McElligott 此前也指出，隨著投資人重新評估AI帶動的經濟成長前景，債券再次成為投資組合的避險工具。
另一方面，AI相關信用利差已擴大至今年以來最寬水準，顯示市場對融資風險的關注升高。高盛此前曾警告，信貸市場可能維持平靜，直到AI資本支出帶動的新一波債務融資需求重新浮現。
如今，AI股票回檔與信用利差擴大，正考驗仰賴持續融資及資本支出擴張的AI成長模式。
不過，高盛提醒，短期資金流向改變，尚不足以扭轉美債市場的結構性供需壓力。預計2027年AI資本支出將達約1.6兆美元，且債務融資占比持續上升。只要AI投資前景未出現實質性崩塌，相關融資需求仍可能轉化為美債供給壓力。
換言之，AI股票遭到拋售雖可能為美債帶來短期買盤，但若要形成持續性的支撐，仍需要更廣泛的股市下跌，或經濟成長前景進一步惡化。

高盛仍看好12月升息　市場重新定價難度升高

聯準會10月會議召開前，儘管通膨數據偏熱，市場對當月升息的預期已大幅降溫。
Codacci-Pisanelli指出，通膨表現為升息提供理由，但聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）此前拒絕對後續利率決策作出明確指引，市場逐漸傾向認為，聯準會將在10月暫緩升息，將政策調整留至12月。
高盛仍將12月升息列為基本情境，但認為市場不容易重新完整反映升息25個基點的預期。隨著股市波動加劇，投資人必須權衡升息對風險資產的衝擊，以及金融環境收緊可能進一步拖累經濟的風險。
高盛數據顯示，截至10月23日，市場對聯準會12月升息的定價約為90%，並預期截至2027年9月累計升息約2.7次。儘管市場已在相當程度上反映升息預期，未來政策走向仍存在高度不確定性。
這也意味著，美債殖利率回落不代表利率已經見頂。若AI投資放緩進一步削弱經濟成長預期，美債可能持續受惠於避險需求；但若能源價格維持高檔、通膨遲遲無法降溫，緊縮貨幣政策與美債供給壓力仍可能再次推升殖利率。
paras_en: US Treasury yields have recently fallen sharply from recent highs, as the two forces that were pushing rates higher—AI investment frenzy and energy price shocks—are now moving in different directions. Goldman Sachs notes that as AI stocks face selling pressure, funds are flowing back into long‑term US Treasuries, but financing demand from AI investments and inflation risk from energy prices have not dissipated, making a Fed rate hike in December uncertain.
Last Thursday (the 22nd), the US 10‑year Treasury yield fell 17 basis points in a single day, the biggest one‑day drop since March 2023, and slipped back below the 5% threshold.

Goldman Sachs fixed‑income, currency and commodities strategist Cosimo Codacci‑Pisanelli said in a new report that AI‑driven trading, which had previously pushed yields up, is now one of the reasons yields are falling back.
As AI stocks are sold off, investors are turning to long‑term US Treasuries for safety, reversing the stock‑bond correlation and making bonds a hedge again for equity portfolios again.

However, this does not mean the upside risk to US Treasury yields has been eliminated. Ongoing capital spending and debt financing by AI firms, together with unclear energy price and inflation trends, could affect US Treasury supply‑demand dynamics and the Fed’s rate decisions.

Goldman still expects a Fed rate hike in December but believes the market will struggle to fully price in a 25‑basis‑point increase. With AI growth prospects, energy prices and Treasury supply‑demand relationships evolving, investors must watch for slowing economic growth and cannot ignore persistent inflation that could keep the Fed on a tight policy path.

AI trading reversal – US Treasuries regain safe‑haven appeal. Codacci‑Pisanelli attributes the recent Treasury yield decline to three factors: high rates beginning to suppress AI‑related asset performance, heightened tail‑risk from a sharp slowdown in AI‑driven growth, and a shift in stock‑bond correlation that restores long‑term Treasuries as a hedge against equity risk.

This contrasts with earlier this month’s hotter US inflation data and the simultaneous drop in stocks and bonds. Nomura strategist Charlie McElligott also noted that as investors reassess AI‑driven growth outlooks, bonds are once again becoming a portfolio hedge.

Meanwhile, AI‑related credit spreads have widened to their widest level this year, indicating heightened market concern over financing risk. Goldman previously warned that the credit market could stay calm until a new wave of debt financing driven by AI capital spending re‑emerges.
Now, the pull‑back in AI stocks and widening credit spreads are testing the AI growth model that relies on continuous financing and capital‑expenditure expansion.

Goldman cautions that short‑term fund‑flow shifts are insufficient to reverse the structural supply‑demand pressure in the Treasury market. It projects AI capital spending to reach about $1.6 trillion by 2027, with debt financing’s share continuing to rise. As long as AI investment prospects do not collapse materially, financing demand could keep adding pressure on Treasury supply.

In other words, while AI stock sell‑offs may provide a short‑term buying boost for Treasuries, sustained support would require a broader equity market decline or a further deterioration in growth outlooks.

Goldman still sees a December rate hike as likely, but market repricing is becoming more difficult. Ahead of the Fed’s October meeting, despite hotter inflation data, expectations for a rate increase that month have cooled sharply.

Codacci‑Pisanelli notes that inflation gives the Fed a reason to hike, but Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has previously refused to give clear guidance on future rate moves, leading the market to increasingly expect a pause in October and a policy adjustment pushed to December.

Goldman continues to treat a December hike as the baseline scenario, but believes the market will find it hard to fully reflect a 25‑basis‑point increase. With heightened equity volatility, investors must weigh the impact of a hike on risk assets and the risk that tighter financial conditions could further drag on the economy.

Goldman data show that as of October 23, the market’s pricing of a December Fed hike was about 90%, and it expects roughly 2.7 cumulative hikes by September 2027. Although the market has largely incorporated the hike expectation, the policy path remains highly uncertain.

This also means that the Treasury yield pull‑back does not signal a rate‑peak. If AI investment slows further, weakening growth expectations, Treasuries could keep benefiting from safe‑haven demand; but if energy prices stay high and inflation remains stubborn, tighter monetary policy and Treasury supply pressure could again push yields higher.

items.title: PHP爆重大漏洞 全網恐慌48小時！救火者竟是位20年志工
items.title_en: Major PHP Vulnerability Sparks 48‑Hour Global Panic; Rescue Led by a 20‑Year Volunteer
paras: 全球約七成網站使用的PHP曝出重大漏洞，引發48小時資安恐慌，各國政府網站緊急下線，攻擊嘗試迅速攀升。協助大量網站搶修的關鍵人物，卻是一位鮮為人知的捷克志工Ondřej Surý。
他將修補程式打包成可直接安裝的套件，讓網站管理員加速更新，也讓網路基礎設施長期仰賴少數志工的脆弱現實浮上檯面。
PHP支撐全球約七成網站運作，這次被稱為「PHP2Shell」的兩個漏洞，通用漏洞評分系統（CVSS）分數均達9.2分，允許未經身分驗證的攻擊者，在伺服器上執行任意程式碼。
這意味著，攻擊者不需要密碼或特殊權限，就可能接管伺服器。不過，PHP的普及率並不代表所有使用PHP的網站都已遭到入侵。
漏洞提前曝光 全球網站急拉警報
Cloudflare執行長Matthew Prince表示，漏洞公開前10小時，公司網路已觀察到數千次利用漏洞的嘗試；公開後45分鐘增至數萬次，兩小時內達數十萬次，之後更累積至數百萬次。
德國聯邦資訊科技中心預防性關閉多個政府網站，芬蘭、法國及比利時也對公共部門網站採取保護措施。美國網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）、歐盟CERT-EU及英國國家網路安全中心（NCSC）則接連發布警告。
CERT-EU提醒，許多商用與開源產品採用PHP作為後端，即使沒有直接對外提供PHP服務，也可能受到影響。
修補提前一天 管理員被迫搶時間
PHP安全團隊原定週四發布修補程式，但漏洞資訊提前外洩，一段概念驗證攻擊示範影片開始流傳，迫使團隊將發布時間提前至週三，準備時間因此少了一天。
影片來自軟體供應鏈安全公司Chainguard。該公司執行長表示，團隊使用公司的AI工具及一款先進模型，只下達「找出PHP中的嚴重漏洞」這類基本指令，就找到了同一批記憶體毀損漏洞。
Chainguard隨後與PHP維護者合作，確認部分發現與既有漏洞報告相符，並協助測試修補程式。他強調，這些漏洞相當複雜，團隊花了好幾個月，才做出真正可用的修補程式。
他也警告，往後只要知道某款軟體存在漏洞，就可能在幾小時內開發出攻擊程式，甚至不必事先掌握漏洞的確切位置。
關鍵一步 靠志工完成
危機升高之際，Surý的名字開始在Reddit與X上被反覆提起。一名PHP社群用戶寫道：「Ondřej今天會拯救網路。」
軟體開發者Ian Landsman也發文形容，世界上大部分PHP發行版都仰賴這個人維護，如果他出了什麼事，許多人都會受到牽連。
這種說法雖有誇張成分，卻凸顯Surý在軟體更新流程中的重要性。他的正職是Internet Systems Consortium的DNS工程總監，維護PHP套件則是持續超過20年的志工工作，也不是由PHP基金會支付薪資。
他的任務並非獨自修復漏洞，而是將PHP專案發布的原始碼，打包成能直接安裝到伺服器上的軟體套件，讓網站管理員更快完成更新。
沒有這一步，使用者仍可取得原始碼自行編譯，但過程更複雜，也不是每個人都具備相關技能。透過預先準備好的套件，同一份更新便能部署到數百、數千台伺服器，省去各自編譯的時間。
網路一片恐慌 他卻相當冷靜
Surý接受《大西洋月刊》訪問時表示，外界雖然恐慌，這48小時對他而言卻沒有特別瘋狂。
原因之一是，他已經做這份工作超過20年，許多流程早已自動化；另一個原因則是，他自己沒有任何運行PHP的系統，可以專注準備套件。
他認為，PHP專案事先將他納入知情範圍，讓他能在漏洞公開前做好準備，才是這次能及時應對的重要因素。
「現在出了狀況，需要解決，解決的方法也明確了。我有時間做好準備。」他如此形容當時的心情。
但他也坦言，如果事發時自己正在亞得里亞海中央的船上，情況就可能完全不同。這個假設也點出，當大量網站依賴少數維護者時，個人的時間與可用性，都可能影響更新速度。
延宕近兩年 暴露結構性問題
這場危機不只是漏洞提前曝光的結果，也揭開開源軟體長期面臨的資源問題。
PHP基金會事後承認，其中一個漏洞的修復線索，早在2024年的外部安全稽核中就已出現，但因資源不足、決策流程效率低落，加上真正深入理解PHP引擎內部機制的人太少，修復工作延宕近兩年。
基金會將此稱為「結構性失敗」，而這個問題並未因緊急修補就獲得解決。
Surý的志工工作，長期以來主要靠金額不大的捐款支持。這次事件受到關注後，他在24小時內收到的捐款，幾乎相當於過去一整年的總額。
他也開始與軟體公司Freexian的Raphaël Hertzog討論緊急接手方案。Surý表示，自己的優勢是多年經驗，知道如何讓系統正常運作，而Freexian同樣具備專業能力，必要時可以接手。
修補尚未完成 風險仍在
Surý指出，若未及時更新，最基本的後果是網站遭破壞或癱瘓；攻擊者也可能取得設備控制權，將其納入殭屍網路，出售相關服務，或利用伺服器挖掘加密貨幣。
他認為，這類攻擊如今主要涉及具有經濟動機的組織犯罪集團，已不只是出於好玩的個人行為。由於並非所有使用者都完成修補與升級，這些風險仍然存在。
至於網路流傳「部分舊版PHP無法修補，三分之一網路永久受損」的說法，Surý明確否認。他表示，舊版也有修補方法，只要使用者願意處理，仍能完成更新。
AI加快攻防 維護資源不能再忽視
這次PHP漏洞由Wiz、Calif與OpenAI研究人員借助AI發現，也讓外界更加擔心，AI找出及利用漏洞的速度，可能超過防禦者的應變能力。
此前，資安社群已因一連串漏洞事件感到不安。約翰霍普金斯大學教授、密碼學家Matthew Green甚至形容，網路像是一堆乾燥的引火物，只差有人找到火柴。
Surý同意，資安攻防正在加速，防禦者也能利用大型語言模型主動找出漏洞。但他認為，根本問題仍是人們把資訊科技基礎設施視為理所當然，沒有投入足夠的維護資金與重視。
他希望，從開源軟體獲益最多的企業，能為維護者付出的時間與勞動提供回報。若長期依賴少數人的熱情，卻不給予相應支持，最終可能讓他們失去持續投入的動力。
對Surý而言，社群留言與感謝郵件讓他感受到工作的價值。但這場48小時危機留下的問題，遠超過一位幕後英雄的故事：支撐大量網站運作的基礎設施，如何獲得足夠資源，讓維護工作能夠持續下去。
paras_en: Around 70% of websites worldwide that run on PHP have been exposed to a critical vulnerability, triggering a 48‑hour cybersecurity panic. Government sites in several countries were taken offline urgently, and attack attempts surged rapidly. The key figure helping countless sites with emergency fixes is a little‑known Czech volunteer, Ondřej Surý.

He packaged the patches into installable bundles, enabling site administrators to update quickly, and highlighting the fragile reality that the internet’s infrastructure long relies on a handful of volunteers.

PHP powers roughly 70% of global websites. The two flaws, dubbed “PHP2Shell,” each score 9.2 on the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) and allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on servers.
This means an attacker can take over a server without a password or special privileges, though PHP’s ubiquity does not imply every PHP‑powered site has been compromised.
Vulnerability Leaked Early, Global Sites Sound the Alarm

Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said that in the ten hours before the vulnerability was publicly disclosed, the company observed thousands of exploitation attempts; within 45 minutes of disclosure the number rose to tens of thousands, reaching hundreds of thousands in two hours and eventually climbing into the millions.

Germany’s Federal Office for Information Security pre‑emptively shut down several government sites, while Finland, France and Belgium took protective measures for public‑sector sites. The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), EU‑CERT‑EU and the UK’s National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) also issued alerts in quick succession.
EU‑CERT‑EU warned that many commercial and open‑source products use PHP as a backend; even sites that do not expose PHP directly may be affected.
Patch Released a Day Early, Administrators Scramble for Time

The PHP security team had planned to release the patch on Thursday, but the vulnerability details leaked early and a proof‑of‑concept video began circulating, forcing the team to move the release up to Wednesday and lose a day of preparation.

The video originated from software‑supply‑chain security firm Chainguard. Its CEO said the team used the company’s AI tools and an advanced model, issuing only a basic command like “find critical PHP vulnerabilities,” which uncovered the same set of memory‑corruption bugs.

Chainguard then collaborated with the PHP maintainers, confirming that some findings matched existing reports and helped test the patch. He emphasized that the flaws are highly complex and required several months of work to produce a truly usable fix.
He also warned that once a software’s vulnerability is known, an exploit can be crafted within hours, even without pinpointing the exact flaw location beforehand.
A Critical Step Carried Out by a Volunteer
As the crisis escalated, Surý’s name began trending repeatedly on Reddit and X. One PHP community member wrote, “Ondřej will save the internet today.”
Software developer Ian Landsman also posted that most PHP distributions rely on this person for maintenance, and if something happened to him, many would be affected.

While hyperbolic, the comment underscores Surý’s importance in the PHP update workflow. His day job is DNS engineering director at the Internet Systems Consortium; maintaining PHP packages has been his volunteer work for over 20 years and is not salaried by the PHP Foundation.
His role is not to fix the bugs alone but to package the PHP project’s source code into installable software bundles, allowing site operators to apply updates more quickly.

Without this step, users could still obtain the source and compile it themselves, but the process is more complex and requires expertise. Pre‑built packages let the same update be deployed to hundreds or thousands of servers, saving the time needed for individual builds.
Internet Panic, Yet He Remains Calm
When interviewed by The Atlantic, Surý said that although the outside world was panicking, the 48‑hour episode was not especially chaotic for him.

One reason is that he has been doing this work for over two decades and many processes are automated; another is that he personally does not run any production PHP systems, allowing him to focus on preparing the packages.
He believes that the PHP project’s practice of informing him ahead of a public disclosure enabled him to be ready, which was crucial for the timely response.
“When something goes wrong, the solution is clear. I have time to prepare,” he described his mindset at the time.

He admitted, however, that if he had been on a boat in the middle of the Adriatic when the issue surfaced, the situation could have been very different. The scenario highlights how the availability of a few maintainers can dictate the speed of updates for countless sites.
Two‑Year Delay Reveals Structural Issues
The crisis is not only the result of early leakage but also exposes the chronic resource constraints faced by open‑source software.

The PHP Foundation later acknowledged that clues to fix one of the bugs appeared in an external security audit in 2024, but due to limited resources, slow decision‑making and a shortage of deep‑knowledge engineers, the fix was delayed by almost two years.
The foundation labeled this a “structural failure,” noting that an emergency patch does not resolve the underlying problem.
Surý’s volunteer work has long relied on modest donations. After the incident drew attention, he received in 24 hours roughly the same amount of donations that he normally collects in an entire year.

He also began discussing an emergency takeover plan with Raphaël Hertzog of software company Freexian. Surý said his advantage lies in years of experience and knowing how to keep systems running, while Freexian has the professional capacity to step in if needed.
Patch Not Yet Complete, Risks Remain

Surý warned that without timely updates, the most basic consequence is a compromised or defunct website; attackers could also gain control of the host, add it to a botnet, sell related services, or use the server for cryptocurrency mining.
He believes such attacks now mainly involve financially motivated organized crime groups, not just hobbyist pranksters. Because not every user has applied the patches, these risks persist.

Regarding the circulating claim that “one‑third of the internet is permanently damaged because older PHP versions cannot be patched,” Surý categorically denied it, stating that older versions can be patched as long as users are willing to apply the fixes.
AI Accelerates Attack and Defense, Maintenance Can No Longer Be Ignored

The PHP flaws were discovered by researchers from Wiz, Calif and OpenAI using AI, raising concerns that AI‑driven vulnerability discovery and exploitation may outpace defenders’ response capabilities.

Previously, the security community has been uneasy about a string of vulnerability incidents. Johns Hopkins professor and cryptographer Matthew Green likened the internet to a pile of dry tinder, waiting for someone to strike a match.

Surý agrees that cyber offense and defense are accelerating, and defenders can also use large language models to proactively find bugs. However, he argues the root issue is that society treats information‑technology infrastructure as a given, without investing sufficient maintenance funding and attention.

He hopes that companies that benefit most from open‑source software will compensate maintainers for their time and labor. Relying long‑term on a few passionate volunteers without proper support could eventually drain their motivation to continue contributing.

For Surý, community messages and thank‑you emails affirm the value of his work. Yet the 48‑hour crisis leaves questions far beyond a single behind‑the‑scenes hero: how can the critical infrastructure that powers countless websites secure enough resources to sustain ongoing maintenance?

items.title: AI交易降溫引爆跨資產震盪！野村示警：科技巨頭資本支出進退兩難
items.title_en: AI Trading Cool‑down Sparks Cross‑Asset Turbulence; Nomura Warns Tech Giants Face a Capital‑Spending Dilemma
paras: 野村證券跨資產策略師 Charlie McElligott 指出，市場對人工智慧（AI）投資的態度正從盲目追捧轉向嚴格檢視，無論大型科技企業持續加碼資本支出，或放緩投資腳步，都可能引發市場疑慮。隨著投資人持倉過度集中、相似交易策略陸續平倉，賣壓正從科技股擴散至債券、匯率及大宗商品市場，股債相關性也出現反轉。儘管期權市場仍有資金押注 AI 類股反彈，但後續行情能否企穩，仍取決於科技巨頭財報、聯準會決策，以及市場能否重新消化 AI 資本支出與成長前景的不確定性。
報告進一步從AI投資邏輯的轉變、市場持倉引發的連鎖反應、股債與其他資產的變化，以及期權市場透露的反向訊號等面向，剖析這波市場震盪的成因與後續觀察重點。

AI資本支出陷兩難　加碼與放緩都可能引發賣壓

McElligott 指出，市場評估大型雲端業者資本支出的方式正在改變。過去，企業增加AI投資被視為需求強勁的證明，即使縮減支出，也可能被解讀為改善資本配置、提高財務紀律。
然而，這套原本能為市場提供正面解讀的邏輯，如今正逐漸失效，投資人面臨的是兩種選擇都可能引發疑慮的局面。
如果大型雲端業者繼續擴大資本支出，自由現金流將承受更大壓力，市場也會更加關注企業能否持續籌措資金，以及融資成本是否進一步攀升。
若企業必須以更大規模發債、並支付更高利差來支應AI基礎設施投資，市場可能開始質疑這種成長模式能否長期維持。McElligott認為，Meta(META-US) 最新財報已透露相關風險正在浮現。
另一種情境是企業大幅放慢AI投資。這不僅可能影響市場對AI需求的判斷，也將動搖投資人對技術普及、企業獲利成長及生產力提升的期待。
McElligott認為，相較於持續加碼所引發的融資疑慮，資本支出明顯減速可能帶來更大衝擊，因為這將使市場重新檢視支撐整波AI行情的成長預期。
無論哪種情境成真，AI相關資產都可能面臨賣壓，而市場持倉結構也使風險進一步升高。
9月AI代理概念股行情期間，投資人重新累積大量多頭部位，並積極買進看漲期權。一旦市場風向轉變，這些集中持倉便可能成為加速撤出的壓力來源，使原本針對AI前景的疑慮，進一步演變成更廣泛的市場震盪。

持倉過度集中放大震盪　去槓桿壓力擴散至全球資產

McElligott 認為，近期市場劇烈波動，除了AI投資前景轉變，投資部位過度集中也是加劇賣壓的重要因素。
野村交易台數據顯示，在波動最劇烈的單日交易中，追蹤的124組美股多空配對交易裡，有47組的波動幅度超過3個標準差、26組超過4個標準差，另有6組超過5個標準差。
這反映當時市場的價格變動已相當極端，壓力也不再只是單一產業的資金輪動，而是波及多組原本採取不同多空配置的交易。
McElligott進一步指出，今年以來，多種高夏普比率策略的獲利表現集中，套息交易與趨勢追蹤策略也呈現高度一致的方向。隨著第四季接近尾聲，基金經理在面臨投資回撤時，可能更重視守住既有獲利與降低風險，而非繼續押注市場反彈，進一步加快縮減部位的速度。
這股調整壓力也已超出AI類股範圍。隨著投資人陸續解除擁擠交易，賣壓與資金重新配置開始傳導至美國公債、外匯及大宗商品市場。
McElligott指出，美債殖利率下滑，正為先前受到冷落的非AI資產帶來轉機，包括押注美元走弱的外匯交易，以及小型股和價值股等類股。
與此同時，槓桿基金的股票淨曝險已降至過去一年、三年及五年來的低點，代表AI交易降溫與債券市場的變化並非各自獨立，而可能是同一波資金重新配置與風險部位調整的不同表現。

股債相關性反轉　AI成長疑慮取代通膨成債市焦點

McElligott 指出，近期市場一項值得關注的變化，是債券與股票市場內部的相關性結構同步出現反轉。
在債券市場，過去一度失效的股債負相關特性重新發揮作用。投資人透過賣出股票期貨、買進美國公債期貨，調整資產配置，讓債券重新成為對沖股票風險的工具。
McElligott 強調，這不只是空頭回補所帶動的行情，而是市場開始將 AI 類股遭到拋售視為成長前景轉弱的訊號，並據此增加避險部位。這也意味著，市場對 AI 成長的疑慮，正逐漸取代通膨成為影響債市定價的重要因素。
股票市場則呈現另一種反轉。2026 年大部分時間，那斯達克指數及半導體類股曾出現相對罕見的現象：市場上漲時，波動率反而高於下跌時。如今，這種關係已轉為股價下跌時波動率同步升高，顯示投資人對下跌風險更加敏感。
McElligott 指出，這項變化在那斯達克指數及VanEck Vectors 半導體 ETF(SMH-US) 上尤其明顯，反映市場正重新評估 AI 資本支出能否持續，以及相關投資是否足以支撐企業未來的成長。
不過，標普500指數的 VIX 波動率指數升幅相對溫和。McElligott 將此歸因於「反向離散」效應：科技股多頭部位遭到重創之際，對利率變化較敏感的類股，以及先前配置偏低或遭放空的標的卻大幅反彈，兩股力量相互抵銷，限制了整體指數波動的升幅。
這也解釋了為何主要股價指數表面上相對平靜，市場內部卻已出現劇烈的因子反轉與資金重新配置。

期權市場仍押注 AI 反彈　波動率能否收斂才是關鍵

儘管市場情緒持續承壓， McElligott 仍在期權市場觀察到部分逆勢訊號。CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Nebius(YNDX-US) 及美光科技(MU-US) 等 AI 相關個股，均出現資金買進價外看漲期權的活動，合約到期時間集中在文中所述的 2025 年 3 至 4 月。
其中，CoreWeave 看漲期權的權利金約 6,900 萬美元，名目曝險約 1.7 億美元；Nebius 的權利金約 2,570 萬美元，名目曝險約 8,000 萬美元；美光則分別約為 2,000 萬美元及 8,500 萬美元。
這些交易顯示，部分投資人即使面對市場震盪，仍持續布局 AI 類股中期反彈。不過，McElligott 並未將這類買盤視為市場趨勢即將反轉的明確訊號。
他認為，接下來更重要的觀察指標，是波動率風險溢價（VRP）賣方是否重新採取過去常見的策略，在波動率上升時進場放空波動率。
其中，當日到期（0DTE）期權的 Gamma 賣出策略尤其值得關注。這類策略透過市場下跌時買進、上漲時賣出的操作，有助於緩和價格波動。若做市商及波動率賣方重新進場，市場波動率才可能再度收斂。
換言之，期權市場的看漲買盤雖透露部分資金仍押注 AI 類股反彈，但要判斷市場是否真正企穩，關鍵不在看漲期權買方是否持續進場，而在波動率賣方能否恢復承接風險、發揮穩定市場的作用。

AI交易進入重新評價期　科技巨頭財報與聯準會決策成關鍵考驗

分析指出，綜合上述訊號， McElligott 認為，近期市場動盪不只是一般的類股回檔，而是 AI 交易正從過去的資本支出熱潮，轉向更嚴格檢視投資效益與成長前景的新階段。
這波變化的傳導過程相互連動：大型雲端業者的 AI 資本支出陷入進退兩難，投資人對成長前景的疑慮升高；9 月累積的集中多頭部位在負面消息衝擊下遭到平倉，賣壓再透過配對交易及趨勢策略擴散至債券、匯率與大宗商品市場，最終引發股債相關性及市場因子表現的反轉。
短期而言，下週 Alphabet、亞馬遜及微軟的財報，加上聯準會利率決策，將成為重要觀察指標。相關結果不僅將影響市場對大型雲端業者未來資本支出規模的判斷，也將檢驗投資人對 AI 成長前景的疑慮是否進一步加深。
更值得關注的是，如果企業放慢 AI 資本支出被市場解讀為需求轉弱，而非改善投資紀律，資金從科技股轉向價值股、小型股及防禦型類股的趨勢，可能就不只是短期避險，而是市場對 2026 年以來各類資產普遍上漲格局的重新評估。
McElligott 指出，多種高夏普比率策略今年以來的獲利表現高度集中。這意味著，當原本持續奏效的交易策略開始失靈，受到衝擊的可能不只是 AI 類股多頭，還包括建立在相似風險因子之上的跨資產部位。若這種連動效應持續，市場面臨的將不只是單一產業修正，而是更廣泛的投資配置與風險承擔模式調整。
paras_en: Nomura Securities cross‑asset strategist Charlie McElligott notes that market sentiment toward artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments is shifting from blind enthusiasm to rigorous scrutiny, and that whether large tech firms continue to ramp up cap‑ex or slow down, both scenarios could raise market concerns. As investors’ positions become overly concentrated and similar trading strategies unwind, selling pressure is spreading from tech stocks to bonds, currencies and commodities, and the stock‑bond correlation is reversing. Although the options market still sees capital betting on a rebound in AI stocks, whether the market can stabilise will depend on tech‑giant earnings, Fed decisions, and the market’s ability to re‑digest the uncertainty around AI cap‑ex and growth prospects.

The report further analyses the market swing by examining the shift in AI‑investment logic, the chain reaction from investors’ position concentrations, changes in equities, bonds and other assets, and the contrarian signals emerging from the options market.

AI cap‑ex is caught in a bind – both scaling up and scaling back can trigger sell‑offs. McElligott says the way the market evaluates large cloud providers’ cap‑ex is changing. Previously, increased AI spending was seen as proof of strong demand, while cuts could be interpreted as better capital allocation and tighter financial discipline.
However, that once‑positive interpretive framework is eroding, leaving investors facing a situation where either choice may raise doubts.

If large cloud providers keep expanding cap‑ex, free‑cash‑flow pressure will rise and the market will focus more on whether firms can keep raising funds and whether financing costs will climb further.

Should firms have to issue larger amounts of debt and pay higher spreads to fund AI infrastructure, the market may begin to question the sustainability of that growth model. McElligott points out that Meta’s (META‑US) latest earnings already hint at such risks emerging.

Another scenario is a sharp slowdown in AI investment, which could not only affect market judgment of AI demand but also shake investors’ expectations about technology diffusion, corporate profit growth and productivity gains.

McElligott believes that, compared with financing concerns triggered by continued spending, a clear slowdown in cap‑ex could have a bigger impact because it forces the market to reassess the growth expectations that have underpinned the AI rally.
Regardless of which scenario materialises, AI‑related assets could face selling pressure, and the current position structure amplifies the risk.

During September’s AI‑themed rally, investors rebuilt large long positions and aggressively bought call options. If market sentiment turns, these concentrated holdings could become a source of rapid unwinding, turning AI‑specific doubts into broader market turbulence.

Over‑concentrated positions amplify volatility; de‑leveraging pressure spreads to global assets. McElligott says that recent sharp market swings are driven not only by the shift in AI outlook but also by the excessive concentration of investment positions.

Nomura’s trading desk data show that on the most volatile single‑day sessions, among 124 tracked US‑equity long‑short pair trades, 47 moved more than three standard deviations, 26 more than four, and six more than five standard deviations.

This reflects that price moves were extreme and pressure was no longer confined to a single sector’s capital flows but spilled over to multiple pairs that had originally taken different long‑short configurations.

McElligott adds that, since the start of the year, profits from a variety of high‑Sharpe‑ratio strategies have become concentrated, with carry‑trade and trend‑following strategies moving in lockstep. As Q4 draws to a close, fund managers facing drawdowns may prioritise preserving existing gains and cutting risk rather than betting on a rebound, accelerating position reductions.

That adjustment pressure has already moved beyond AI stocks. As investors unwind crowded trades, selling pressure and capital reallocation are transmitting to US Treasuries, FX and commodities markets.
McElligott notes that falling US‑bond yields are opening a window for previously neglected non‑AI assets, including dollar‑weakness bets in FX and small‑cap and value stocks.

At the same time, leveraged‑fund net equity exposure has fallen to its lowest level in one, three and five years, indicating that the AI‑trading cool‑down and bond‑market shifts are not separate phenomena but parts of the same capital‑reallocation and risk‑position adjustment wave.

Stock‑bond correlation reversal – AI growth doubts replace inflation as the bond‑market focus. McElligott points out a noteworthy recent change: the internal correlation structure between bonds and equities has flipped.

In the bond market, the previously weakened negative stock‑bond correlation is re‑asserting itself. Investors are selling equity futures and buying US‑Treasury futures, rebalancing assets and restoring bonds as a hedge against equity risk.

McElligott stresses this is not just a short‑cover rally but a market signal that AI stocks are being sold because growth prospects are dimming, prompting a rise in hedging positions. This means doubts about AI growth are increasingly supplanting inflation as a key driver of bond pricing.

Equities show a different reversal. For most of 2026, the Nasdaq and semiconductor stocks displayed the rare pattern of higher volatility on up‑days than down‑days. That relationship has now flipped, with volatility rising as prices fall, indicating investors are more sensitive to downside risk.

McElligott highlights that this shift is especially evident in the Nasdaq index and the VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US), reflecting a market reassessment of whether AI cap‑ex can be sustained and whether related investments can support future corporate growth.

However, the S&P 500 VIX has risen only modestly. McElligott attributes this to a “reverse dispersion” effect: while tech‑stock longs are battered, sectors more sensitive to rate changes and previously under‑weighted or shorted names are rallying, offsetting each other and capping overall index volatility.
This also explains why major indices appear relatively calm on the surface while internal factor reversals and capital reallocation are already intense.

Options market still bets on an AI rebound – volatility convergence is the key. Despite lingering market pressure, McElligott sees contrarian signals in the options market. AI‑related names such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Nebius (YNDX‑US) and Micron Technology (MU‑US) have attracted buying of out‑of‑the‑money calls, with contracts expiring mainly in March‑April 2025.

CoreWeave’s call premiums total about $69 million with a notional exposure of roughly $170 million; Nebius’s premiums are about $25.7 million for a $80 million notional; Micron’s are roughly $20 million and $85 million respectively.
These trades show that some investors continue to position for a mid‑term AI rebound despite market turbulence, but McElligott does not view this buying as a clear sign of an imminent trend reversal.
He believes the more important gauge now is whether sellers of volatility risk premium (VRP) resume their usual strategy of shorting volatility when it spikes.

In particular, same‑day‑expiry (0DTE) gamma‑selling strategies merit attention. Such strategies buy on market declines and sell on rallies, helping to dampen price swings. If market makers and volatility sellers re‑enter, overall volatility may start to converge again.

In other words, while call buying hints that some capital still backs an AI rebound, determining whether the market truly stabilises hinges less on continued call buying and more on whether volatility sellers can resume risk‑taking and stabilising roles.

AI trading enters a re‑evaluation phase – tech‑giant earnings and Fed policy become critical tests. The analysis concludes that, taken together, McElligott sees the recent turbulence not as a simple sector pull‑back but as AI trading moving from a cap‑ex frenzy to a stricter assessment of investment efficiency and growth outlook.

The transmission chain is interlinked: large cloud providers are stuck in a cap‑ex dilemma, raising growth‑outlook doubts; September’s concentrated longs are being liquidated under negative news, spreading sell pressure via pair trades and trend strategies into bonds, FX and commodities, ultimately flipping stock‑bond correlation and factor performance.

In the short term, next week’s earnings from Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft, together with the Fed’s rate decision, will be key gauges. Their outcomes will shape market views on future cloud‑cap‑ex levels and test whether investor concerns about AI growth deepen further.

More importantly, if a slowdown in AI cap‑ex is read as weakening demand rather than improved investment discipline, the shift of capital from tech to value, small‑cap and defensive stocks could signal not just short‑term hedging but a broader reassessment of the upward‑trend that has characterised assets since 2026.

McElligott notes that this year’s profit performance of multiple high‑Sharpe‑ratio strategies has become highly concentrated. This means that when once‑reliable trading approaches start to fail, the impact may extend beyond AI long positions to cross‑asset exposures built on similar risk factors. If this linkage persists, the market faces not merely a sector correction but a wider re‑allocation and risk‑bearing model adjustment.

items.title: 紅到歐洲！中國這門「溫暖生意」大爆單
items.title_en: Red to Europe! China's "Warm Business" Booms
paras: 浙江桐鄉濮院鎮今年前九月毛衫產業外貿成長82%，當地一家企業已向歐洲出口1,200萬件毛衫。隨著海外訂單攀升，業者加快設計與交貨速度，並透過共同開拓市場，將中國秋冬熱銷款推向海外。
濮院是中國規模最大的羊毛衫集散中心，每年交易金額已連續七年突破人民幣千億元。今年秋冬銷售旺季，不僅中國各地採購商湧入，海外需求也同步走強，帶動毛衫產業內外銷雙雙升溫。
在當地一家外貿企業的工廠，數百台織布機滿載運轉，產品主要供應歐洲快時尚品牌，今年出口量已達1,200萬件，較去年同期成長逾20%。
浙江商錦紡織科技公司外貿部經理鄭雲賢表示，歐洲冬季漫長、氣溫偏低，羊毛及羊絨類商品銷售表現良好。今年中國市場熱銷的拉長毛款式引進歐洲後，吸引不少客戶下單，並持續追加訂單。
海外快時尚品牌款式更新快、交期緊，也促使業者提升生產效率。該公司已將打樣時間從四至五天縮短至一天，交貨時間壓縮至兩週內，生產高峰期每天可設計150款針織衫，以因應市場需求。
不過，中小商家規模有限、布局分散，單靠自身力量拓展海外市場並不容易。濮院因此搭建海外拓展服務平台，匯集兩百多家企業共同開拓市場，提供通關、退稅、海外倉儲及海外推廣等一站式服務。
濮院鎮黨委書記羅國良表示，今年前九月，當地專營外貿的登記業者達178家，毛衫產業外貿成長82%。平台今年已與195家企業達成合作意向，累積254家潛在海外客戶，並多次組織商家參加廣交會、上海服裝展等展會，接洽買家。
浙江嘉興濮創服飾總經理何建剛指出，透過展會與海外客戶深入交流後，後續在線上傳送圖片、寄送樣品，就能敲定訂單，未來外貿可望占公司總銷售額三分之一。
海外訂單增加之際，濮院本地市場也迎來轉型。今年前九月，毛衫總成交額達人民幣915.61億元，年增33.5%，零售成長首次超越批發。當地2,400家商家中，近半已投入零售業務，逐步從傳統批發集散地轉向批零兼營。
商家也透過差異化設計、加快推出新品及提升布料品質，爭取消費者。濮院時尚中心商家夏曉豐表示，外套銷量年增約20%，客戶更加重視穿著舒適度，下單後有九成以上會追加補貨。
從零售擴張到攜手拓展海外市場，濮院毛衫業者正同步掌握中國與海外的秋冬商機。
paras_en: Zhejiang's Tongxiang Puyuan Town saw its knitwear export sector grow 82% in the first nine months of the year, and a local company has already shipped 12 million pieces of knitwear to Europe. As overseas orders climb, firms are speeding up design and delivery and, through joint market development, are pushing China’s hot autumn‑winter styles abroad.

Puyuan is China’s largest hub for wool sweaters, with the transaction volume breaking the RMB 100 billion mark for seven consecutive years. During this year’s autumn‑winter peak season, not only have domestic buyers flocked in, but overseas demand has also surged, heating up both domestic and export sales of knitwear.

At the factory of a local foreign‑trade enterprise, hundreds of looms run at full capacity, mainly supplying European fast‑fashion brands. This year its export volume has reached 12 million pieces, up more than 20% from the same period last year.

Zhejiang Shangjin Textile Technology Co.’s foreign‑trade manager Zheng Yunxian said Europe’s long, cold winters make wool and cashmere products sell well. The elongated knit styles that are hot in China this year have been introduced to Europe, attracting many customers who place orders and keep adding to them.

Fast‑fashion brands overseas update styles quickly and demand tight delivery times, prompting firms to boost production efficiency. The company has cut sample‑making time from four‑to‑five days down to one day and shortened delivery to within two weeks, and at peak production can design 150 knitwear styles a day to meet market demand.

However, small and medium‑sized merchants have limited scale and scattered operations, making it hard to expand overseas on their own. Therefore, Puyuan has built an overseas‑expansion service platform that brings together more than 200 companies to jointly develop markets, offering one‑stop services such as customs clearance, tax rebates, overseas warehousing and promotion.

Puyuan Town Party Committee secretary Luo Guoliang said that in the first nine months of the year, there were 178 registered foreign‑trade operators, with knitwear exports up 82%. The platform has already signed cooperation intentions with 195 enterprises, accumulated 254 potential overseas customers, and repeatedly organized merchants to attend the Canton Fair, Shanghai Apparel Expo and other exhibitions to meet buyers.

Zhejiang Jiaxing Puchuang Apparel general manager He Jianggang noted that after in‑depth communication with overseas customers at exhibitions, orders can be sealed by sending pictures and samples online, and foreign trade could eventually account for one‑third of the company’s total sales.

While overseas orders rise, Puyuan’s local market is also transforming. In the first nine months, total knitwear transaction value reached RMB 91.561 billion, a 33.5% year‑on‑year increase, with retail growth surpassing wholesale for the first time. Among the town’s 2,400 merchants, nearly half have entered retail, gradually shifting from a traditional wholesale hub to a combined wholesale‑retail model.

Merchants are also differentiating designs, accelerating new‑product launches and improving fabric quality to win consumers. Summer Xiaofeng of the Puyuan Fashion Center said outer‑wear sales have risen about 20% year‑on‑year, customers now place greater emphasis on comfort, and more than 90% of orders are followed by replenishment purchases.
From retail expansion to jointly tapping overseas markets, Puyuan’s knitwear firms are simultaneously seizing autumn‑winter opportunities at home and abroad.

items.title: 氦氣被列入關鍵材料！美晶片廠遭供應商限量  專家：AI擴產計畫卡在「隱形瓶頸」
items.title_en: Helium Designated a Critical Material! US Chip Makers Face Supplier Rationing; Experts Say AI Expansion Plans Hampered by “Invisible Bottleneck”
paras: 美國能源部上周五(23日)將氦氣正式列為關鍵材料，成為名單中第20種戰略物資。外媒最新報導指出，這項認定將為氦氣生產商打開聯邦融資管道，並強化政府對供應鏈的監測，背後考慮是氦在半導體、量子計算、超導磁體等領域幾乎無可替代，而全球供應正持續受地緣風險擠壓。
《美聯社》報導，氦氣不可燃、沸點極低，部分製程目前沒有替代方案。美國能源部助理部長Audrey Robertson表示，從晶片製造到超級運算都依賴穩定供應。
值得留意的是，氦氣曾入列2018年「關鍵礦產」名單，後來因美國國內供應被認為無虞而被移出，此次重新被能源部納入關鍵材料，顯示官方對供應鏈中斷的擔憂明顯升溫。
現實瓶頸比政策認定更難解。氦氣主要是天然氣加工副產品，美國、卡達、俄羅斯為主要生產國。美國雖是全球最大生產氦氣國家，去年產量約8,100萬立方公尺、佔全球43%，但提取工廠已接近產能極限，新廠從核准到投產需數年。
與此同時，荷姆茲海峽風險衝擊卡達出口，俄羅斯今年也曾臨時限制出口，現貨價格自衝突爆發以來已漲至原先三倍，供應商正動用地下鹽穴庫存補貨。
壓力直接傳導到晶圓廠。半導體產業消耗全球約五分之一的氦氣，明尼阿達州Polar Semiconductors正打算把月產能翻倍至1.4億顆晶片，卻已有三家供應商之一開始限量供貨。
這家美國晶圓代工製造商總裁兼營運長Surya Iyer表示，廠內約40%至50%的設備會以不同工序用到氦，「沒有氦，工廠就得停」。
AI資料中心與電氣化推升晶片需求，也同步放大氦氣需求。政策融資能緩解長期產能，卻補不上眼前缺口，擴產與限量供貨同時發生，半導體供應鏈的「隱形瓶頸」短期內難以消除。
paras_en: The U.S. Department of Energy officially added helium to the list of critical materials last Friday (the 23rd), making it the 20th strategic commodity on the roster. According to recent foreign media reports, the designation will open federal financing channels for helium producers and strengthen government monitoring of the supply chain, reflecting the near‑irreplaceable role of helium in semiconductors, quantum computing, superconducting magnets and other fields, while global supply continues to be squeezed by geopolitical risks.

The Associated Press notes that helium is non‑flammable and has an extremely low boiling point, and for some processes there is currently no substitute. DOE Assistant Secretary Audrey Robertson said that everything from chip manufacturing to supercomputing relies on a stable helium supply.

It is worth noting that helium was on the 2018 “critical minerals” list but was later removed because domestic U.S. supply was deemed secure. Its reinstatement as a critical material by the Energy Department signals a clear rise in official concern over potential supply‑chain disruptions.

The real bottleneck is tougher than the policy label. Helium is mainly a by‑product of natural‑gas processing, with the United States, Qatar and Russia as the main producers. Although the U.S. is the world’s largest helium producer—about 81 million cubic metres last year, or 43 % of global output—its extraction plants are near full capacity and a new plant takes several years from approval to operation.

At the same time, the Houthi‑controlled Strait of Hormuz risk has hit Qatar’s exports, and Russia temporarily restricted shipments earlier this year. Spot prices have risen to roughly three times pre‑conflict levels, prompting suppliers to tap underground salt‑cave inventories to replenish stock.

The pressure is directly felt by wafer fabs. The semiconductor industry consumes roughly one‑fifth of the world’s helium, and Polar Semiconductors in Minnesota plans to double its monthly output to 140 million chips, but one of its three suppliers has already begun rationing deliveries.
Surya Iyer, president and COO of the U.S. foundry, said that about 40 % to 50 % of the fab’s equipment uses helium in various processes, adding, “Without helium, the plant has to shut down.”

AI data centers and electrification are driving up chip demand, which in turn amplifies helium demand. Policy‑driven financing can ease long‑term capacity constraints but cannot fill the immediate shortfall; expansion and rationing are happening simultaneously, making the semiconductor supply chain’s “invisible bottleneck” difficult to eliminate in the short term.

items.title: iPhone Duo「未通過」暴力測試！IP68防塵仍進灰塵、反向彎折致內螢幕失靈
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Fails Durability Test: IP68 Dust Resistance Still Lets Dust In, Reverse Bending Breaks Internal Screen
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款橫向摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 的耐用性面臨考驗。以極限耐用性測試聞名的海外數位部落客 JerryRigEverything 近日公布 iPhone Duo 完整暴力測試影片，結果顯示，這款標榜具備 IP68 防塵等級的旗艦手機，仍未能通過全套耐久測試，成為該部落客七年摺疊手機測試歷程中少數未能達標的產品。
根據《MacRumors》報導，測試首先暴露出 iPhone Duo 的防塵問題。儘管產品標示具備 IP68 防塵能力，大量灰塵仍從轉軸的多處縫隙進入機身內部，甚至侵入開合結構區域，導致負責維持機身閉合的磁鐵功能失效，影響手機正常開合。
接著進行的反向彎折測試，則進一步暴露機身結構的弱點。測試者將手機完全展開後施加反向壓力，中框隨即出現形變，7.6 吋內螢幕也出現永久性綠線，隨後失去觸控反應，導致整支手機無法正常使用。
螢幕抗刮能力方面，iPhone Duo 內外螢幕的表現則呈現明顯差異。採用第二代超瓷晶面板的外螢幕表現符合預期，直到莫氏硬度 7 級的測試條件下，才出現明顯刮痕。
然而，內螢幕的抗刮能力則僅達莫氏硬度 2 級，與一般非霧面版本的摺疊旗艦手機相近，日常使用較容易留下刮痕。
不過，內螢幕表面的霧面奈米紋理塗層，能讓細微刮痕在視覺上幾乎難以察覺。測試者使用沙土、碎石，甚至鎖子甲摩擦機身後，留下的痕跡仍幾乎不可見。
測試結束後，JerryRigEverything 部落客尼爾森表示，從七年前開始測試第一代摺疊手機以來，大多數產品都能順利通過整套驗證，但 iPhone Duo 未能達到標準。
他也提醒使用者，避免將展開狀態的 iPhone Duo 放在座椅上，以免不慎坐上手機，造成機身反向彎折，進而導致內螢幕破裂或中框變形。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US)'s first horizontally folding phone, the iPhone Duo, faces durability challenges. Overseas digital blogger JerryRigEverything, known for extreme durability testing, recently released a full violent test video of the iPhone Duo, showing that this flagship phone, touted with an IP68 dust‑proof rating, did not pass the complete durability suite, becoming one of the few foldables in the blogger’s seven‑year testing history to fall short.

According to MacRumors, the test first exposed a dust‑ingress issue. Although the device is marketed as IP68 dust‑proof, large amounts of dust entered the chassis through multiple gaps around the hinge, even reaching the opening‑closing mechanism area, causing the magnet that keeps the device closed to fail and affecting normal opening and closing of the phone.

The subsequent reverse‑bending test further revealed structural weaknesses. After fully unfolding the phone, the tester applied reverse pressure, causing the mid‑frame to deform and the 7.6‑inch internal screen to develop a permanent green line, after which it lost touch response, rendering the entire device unusable.

Regarding scratch resistance, the iPhone Duo’s outer and inner displays performed markedly differently. The outer screen, using a second‑generation ceramic‑glass panel, met expectations and only showed noticeable scratches under a Mohs hardness of 7.
In contrast, the inner display’s scratch resistance was only at Mohs hardness 2, similar to typical non‑matte foldable flagship phones, making it more prone to everyday scratches.

However, the inner screen’s matte nano‑texture coating makes fine scratches virtually invisible to the eye. The tester rubbed sand, gravel, and even chain‑mail against the device, and the resulting marks remained almost unseen.

After the tests, JerryRigEverything blogger Nelson said that since he began testing foldable phones seven years ago with the first generation, most products have passed the full verification, but the iPhone Duo did not meet the standard.

He also warned users to avoid leaving an unfolded iPhone Duo on a seat, as accidentally sitting on it could cause reverse bending of the chassis, leading to internal screen breakage or mid‑frame deformation.

items.title: 誤會一場 潤泰新：「松濤苑」5樓戶坪價實爲254萬元優於上筆成交
items.title_en: A Misunderstanding: Runtaixin Says the 5th‑Floor Unit at Songtao Garden Actually Sold at NT$2.54 million per Ping, Higher Than the Previous Deal
paras: 原依實價登錄資料顯示，豪宅「松濤苑」今年6月以總價4億6180萬元無貸款交易，成交原潤泰新(9945-TW)的5樓戶，連6個車位共258.22坪，換算單價244.33萬元，但潤泰新指出，此一登錄資料因作業疏失，這筆松濤苑實價登錄漏列車位價1820萬元，因此實際成交價爲4.8億元，坪價爲254萬元且優於上筆交易的250萬元。
潤泰新並強調，目前潤泰新地政部門預計於27日將就此一交易的實價登錄資料實價向地政局申請資料更正。
潤泰新指出， 「松濤苑」5樓戶，由客戶向潤泰新買下，連同6個車位共達258.22坪，扣除車位後的實際銷售每坪單價為254萬元，比前一次成交還高。
如潤泰新對「松濤苑」5樓戶交易實價登錄交易申報完成更正，豪宅社區「松濤苑」完工13年以來的最新成交價格站穩250萬元之上。
台北市中正區植物園景觀豪宅「松濤苑」只興建12樓，總戶數僅20 戶，目前屋齡13年多，依實價登錄交易14筆的資料顯示， 2015年8月，「松濤苑」6樓戶曾創下每坪270.6萬元的社區每坪最高成交單價。
paras_en: According to the original real‑price registration data, the luxury residence "Songtao Garden" was reported to have been sold in June of this year for a total price of NT$461.8 million without a loan, involving Runtaixin's (9945‑TW) 5th‑floor unit together with six parking spaces covering a total of 258.22 ping, which would imply a unit price of NT$2.4433 million per ping. Runtaixin, however, pointed out that the registration omitted the value of the parking spaces—NT$18.2 million—due to a clerical error, so the actual transaction price was NT$480 million, yielding a per‑ping price of NT$2.54 million, which is higher than the previous transaction price of NT$2.5 million.
Runtaixin emphasized that its land‑administration department plans to submit a request to the Land Administration Bureau on the 27th to correct the real‑price registration data for this transaction.

Runtaixin explained that the 5th‑floor unit at "Songtao Garden" was purchased by a client from Runtaixin, including six parking spaces for a total of 258.22 ping; after excluding the parking spaces, the actual sale price per ping is NT$2.54 million, which is higher than the previous deal.

If Runtaixin completes the correction of the real‑price registration for the 5th‑floor unit transaction, the latest sale price of the "Songtao Garden" luxury community—now 13 years since completion—will remain above NT$2.5 million per ping.

The "Songtao Garden" luxury residence in Taipei's Zhongzheng District, adjacent to the Botanical Garden, consists of only 12 floors and 20 units in total. The building is a little over 13 years old, and according to 14 recorded transactions, the highest per‑ping price in the community was set in August 2015 when a 6th‑floor unit sold for NT$2.706 million per ping.

items.title: 美期中選舉前大盤加速趕底 8檔台股搶手型ETF戰力猛
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Election Looms as Taiwan Market Accelerates Bottom‑Finding; Six Semiconductor‑Focused ETFs Among the Hottest Picks
paras: 10 月來外資連續賣超台股，大盤跌得鼻青臉腫，不過，台股ETF中，仍有不少檔績效搶眼，規模成長異軍突起，根據CMoney統計，截至2026/10/22為止，近1年大盤上漲約66.5%，績效表現最好的台股ETF中，出現6檔半導體型、1檔科技型、1檔主動型脫穎而出，不論規模、績效都維持正成長。法人表示，美國期中選舉前，台股行情轉趨震盪，大盤加速趕底過程中，只要績效持續衝高、規模不斷增加，都表示這類ETF獲投資人青睞，是台股搶手型ETF。
根據CMoney統計至10/22止，近1年台股主、被動ETF績效最好的前十強名單中，計有8檔ETF不論績效、規模都雙雙正成長，帶動ETF出現績效好、買氣旺的搶手表現，績效方面，台新臺灣IC設計(00947-TW)上漲122.31%，表現最好，而兆豐台灣晶圓製造(00913-TW)、野村臺灣新科技50(00935-TW)分別上漲120.25%、108.55%，緊追在後。
至於主動式台股ETF，則有主動統一台股增長ETF(00981A-TW)唯一進榜；排名第5到10名，全數由半導體ETF擔綱，依序為中信00891、富邦00892、台新00904、群益00927等，財富管理專家分析，今年半導體類股表現強勢，不少重量級個股從年初迄今一路表現強勢，是台股多頭的領頭羊，帶動半導體ETF績效也跟著水漲船高。
規模方面，唯一進榜的主動統一台股增長ETF(00981A-TW)，近1年規模成長1,231.56%，增幅強壓其他台股被動ETF，表現亦一枝獨秀；而其他半導體ETF如群益00927、台新00947、中信00891，台新00904四檔，規模也都有約1至5倍不等的增幅。

台新00904、00947兩檔ETF經理人黃鈺民表示，台積電10月法說，已再次確認全球半導體的晶片需求強勁，獲利能見度拉高，AI需求也將持續為半導體供應鏈帶來新訂單，從最新8月台灣外銷訂單首度突破千億美元，年增逾7成來看，台灣AI、半導體供應鏈接單能力強，在企業營運業績展望亮麗下，預估2027年台灣半導體企業憑藉先進製程技術、成熟供應鏈生態系及長期客戶夥伴深厚關係，競爭護城河仍保持完整，全球半導體供應鏈的核心地位短期內難以被取代。
他建議投資人趁現在台股盤勢不穩，可分批持有台灣半導體產業型ETF或聚焦AI擴散行情帶旺IC設計、記憶體為核心的IC設計產業ETF，掌握全球AI紅利引爆、行情擴散下的科技股新牛勢。

paras_en: In October, foreign investors have been net sellers of Taiwanese stocks, leaving the market bruised, yet several Taiwan‑stock ETFs have posted eye‑catching performance and rapid asset growth. According to CMoney data up to 2026‑10‑22, the broader market rose about 66.5% over the past year, and the best‑performing ETFs include six semiconductor‑focused, one technology‑focused and one active‑managed fund, all showing positive growth in both scale and returns. Analysts say that ahead of the U.S. midterm elections the Taiwan market is becoming more volatile, and as the index races toward a bottom, ETFs that keep delivering strong returns and expanding assets are clearly favored by investors, making them the most sought‑after Taiwan ETFs.

Based on CMoney’s ranking as of 10/22, eight of the top‑ten performing Taiwan ETFs—both active and passive—have seen simultaneous growth in returns and assets, driving a hot‑buyer market. In terms of performance, Taishin Taiwan IC Design (00947‑TW) led with a 122.31% gain, followed by Mega Financial Taiwan Wafer Manufacturing (00913‑TW) up 120.25% and Nomura Taiwan New Technology 50 (00935‑TW) up 108.55%.

Among active Taiwan ETFs, only the Active Uni‑Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW) made the list. Positions five through ten were all occupied by semiconductor ETFs: CTBC 00891, Fubon 00892, Taishin 00904 and Yuanta 00927, in that order. Wealth‑management experts note that semiconductor stocks have been strong this year, with many heavyweight names delivering robust performance since the start of the year, leading the market’s bullish trend and lifting semiconductor‑ETF returns along with it.

In terms of scale, the sole active entrant, Uni‑Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW), grew its assets by 1,231.56% over the past year, outpacing all other passive Taiwan ETFs and standing out uniquely. The other semiconductor ETFs—Yuanta 00927, Taishin 00947, CTBC 00891 and Taishin 00904—also posted asset increases ranging roughly from one‑ to five‑fold.

ETF managers Huang Yu‑min of Taishin 00904 and 00947 said TSMC’s October earnings call reaffirmed strong global chip demand and raised profit visibility, with AI driving new orders throughout the semiconductor supply chain. Taiwan’s August export orders broke the US$100 billion mark for the first time, up more than 70% year‑over‑year, underscoring the island’s AI and semiconductor order‑taking strength. Looking ahead to 2027, they expect Taiwanese semiconductor firms to maintain a solid competitive moat thanks to advanced process technology, a mature supply‑chain ecosystem and deep long‑term customer relationships, keeping Taiwan at the core of the global semiconductor supply chain in the near term.

He advises investors to take advantage of the current market volatility by gradually building positions in Taiwan semiconductor‑industry ETFs or ETFs focused on AI‑driven IC design and memory sectors, to capture the new tech‑stock rally sparked by global AI dividends and market diffusion.

items.title: 胡連斥2.5億元收購LA PUNTA 8成股權 跨足高端重機與頂級超跑供應鏈
items.title_en: Hu Lian Announces NT$250 Million Purchase of 80% Stake in LA PUNTA, Expanding into High-End Motorcycle and Supercar Supply Chains
paras: 連接器廠胡連(6279-TW)今(24)日公告，旗下義大利子公司Hu Lane Associate Europe S.r.l.已簽署股權買賣合約，將以688萬歐元(約新台幣2.5億元)收購義大利公司LA PUNTA S.R.L. 80%股權，跨足高端重機與頂級超跑供應鏈，交易預計於明年1月底完成。
胡連表示，本次收購主要為進行歐洲產業垂直與橫向整合，以滿足集團未來營運成長需求，透過收購不僅將跨足高端重機與頂級超跑供應鏈，還可分散單一區域市場風險、提升國際市場營收比重及前端研發與客訴回應速度，推動技術升級及多元產業延伸。
胡連表示，此次收購金額688萬歐元，其中企業價值為576萬歐元，另包含淨負債及營運資金112萬歐元，本次交易以現金為對價，資金來源為自有資金及銀行借款，收購完成後，將持續經營標的公司既有業務，並與現任經營團隊合作，整合集團資源，拓展國際市場及客戶基礎。
交易價格方面，胡連表示，公司委託國富浩華聯合會計師事務所評估，採用市場法中的可類比公司法及收益法中的現金流量折現法，分別賦予50%權重。市場法篩選7家全球公開發行的可類比公司，以本益比第一四分位數12.42倍作為評價依據；收益法則依標的公司未來預估現金流量進行折現。
經綜合評估，標的公司80%股權對應的企業價值合理區間為552.7萬至626.1萬歐元(未含淨負債及營運資金部位)，本次交易採用的企業價值576萬歐元落在上述合理區間內，因此，會計師認為交易價格尚屬合理。
paras_en: Connector maker Hu Lian (6279‑TW) announced today that its Italian subsidiary Hu Lane Associate Europe S.r.l. has signed a share purchase agreement to acquire an 80% stake in Italy’s LA PUNTA S.R.L. for €6.88 million (approximately NT$250 million). The deal, which will bring the company into the high‑end motorcycle and top‑tier supercar supply chain, is expected to close by the end of January next year.

Hu Lian said the acquisition is aimed at achieving vertical and horizontal integration of its European operations to meet future growth needs. By entering the high‑end motorcycle and supercar supply chain, the group can diversify regional market risk, increase the share of international revenue, and improve front‑end R&D and customer‑complaint response speed, thereby driving technology upgrades and diversification into new industries.

The purchase price of €6.88 million comprises an enterprise value of €5.76 million plus net debt and working capital of €1.12 million. The transaction will be paid in cash, funded by the company’s own resources and bank loans. After closing, Hu Lian will continue to operate the target’s existing business, cooperate with the current management team, integrate group resources, and expand its international market and customer base.

Regarding valuation, Hu Lian engaged Guo Fu Hao Hua United CPA Firm, which applied a 50/50 weighting of the market‑approach comparable‑company method and the income‑approach discounted cash‑flow method. The market approach screened seven publicly listed global peers and used the first‑quartile P/E multiple of 12.42× as the benchmark; the income approach discounted the target’s projected future cash flows.

Based on the combined assessment, the reasonable range for the enterprise value of the 80% stake is €5.527 million to €6.261 million (excluding net debt and working capital). The €5.76 million enterprise value used in this transaction falls within that range, so the accountants consider the purchase price to be reasonable.

paras_en: AI accelerator compute demand is exploding, and next‑generation chips require much larger substrate area and more layers, driving a sharp rise in demand for high‑end ABF substrates. With longer equipment lead times and much tougher processes, the high‑end supply‑demand gap is expected to widen through 2028. Global tech giants have already launched long‑term contracts and prepaid orders to lock in supply, signalling that pricing power has officially shifted from buyers to suppliers.
"Size and layer count surge non‑linearly, equivalent processing area climbs, testing process yield,"

In advanced packaging architectures, AI chips integrate more compute cores and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), causing the photomask size to expand from 1× in early generations to 3×, even over 9×. Substrate specifications have likewise jumped from the former 55 × 55 mm to 110 × 110 mm and to complex stacks of 26 layers or more. This drives a non‑linear explosion in equivalent processing area. Large area and high layer counts not only consume far more production capacity, they also magnify warpage caused by differences in coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) and make line‑up alignment far more difficult. Manufacturers that can achieve high‑volume production and yield control will command a premium for their technology.
"Glass and ceramic cores poised to take off, new materials force a technological shift,"

To overcome the physical warpage and thermal limits of traditional organic substrates at ultra‑large sizes, glass‑core substrates and ceramic intermediate layers have become the key breakthrough for next‑generation high‑end packaging. Although the new architectures initially face challenges in processing precision and yield maturity, major Taiwanese and Japanese firms have already begun early‑stage technology positioning. By introducing ultra‑low‑CTE materials, automated routing and design‑for‑manufacturability (DFM) rules, the supply chain is accelerating the transition from traditional organic cores to emerging inorganic materials. In the medium‑to‑long term this will unlock another wave of value‑creation from material upgrades in the substrate industry.

items.title: 旅遊業衝刺線上旅展買氣 這些航點和機票都有優惠
items.title_en: Travel Industry Boosts Online Travel Fair Sales; Discounts on These Routes and Airfares
paras: 全台最大旅展─2026 ITF台灣國際旅展將於11月6日至11月9日登場，不少大型觀光和航空業者已先行開跑線上旅展，適逢颱風和連假，本周末先爆出一波旅遊買氣，包括機票、主題行程買氣均熱。
雄獅(2731-TW)表示，今年冬季旅遊訂單人數已較去年成長3成，主要受惠於機票價格趨穩，且有超過6成的既有會員回流購買，旅客出遊相較「旅行目的地」更重「旅行目的」，赴日旅客逾7成以「溫泉、美食、雪國」為冬遊三大主題。
雄獅進一步觀察，短線旅客也偏好拉長天數慢遊，日本6天以上長天數團體人數成長4成，東南亞則轉向五星飯店與渡假村等重住宿的度假型態，而長線則因國際轉機航班與航網逐步恢復、票價趨穩，使歐洲訂單成長達6成，不少旅客半年前就提前卡位，以北歐極光、雪梨跨年最熱銷。
雄獅看好冬季與春節買氣，預估此波線上旅展業績年增幅將達雙位數。
而長榮航(2618-TW)指出，線上旅展已開跑，精選航線82折起(均未稅)，其中，瞄準短期快閃旅客需求，推出桃園-香港最低只要3280元起、桃園-首爾6059元起、桃園-沖繩6640元起，而旅客最愛的日本航線，松山-羽田最低11305元起；而長程旅行中，桃園-印度德里只要13940元起、桃園-布里斯本15334元起、桃園-維也納22950元起，以及桃園-舊金山27000元起(含稅)。
同時，長榮航將以「印度皇宮」為主題打造實體華麗旅展展場，藉此歡慶12月1日即將開航的桃園-印度德里航線。
華航(2610-TW)則指出，今年旅展主打熱門航線最低76折起(均未稅)，其中，台北-布里斯本15957元起、台北-雪梨16188元起，台北-墨爾本、台北-奧克蘭同樣18000元有找，而台北-宿霧3354元起、台北-釜山5994元起。
華航將於10月25日在紐澳航線全面增班，雪梨增為每周7班、布里斯本增至每周6班、墨爾本增至每周5班。
paras_en: The largest travel fair in Taiwan—the 2026 ITF Taiwan International Travel Expo—will be held from November 6 to November 9. Many major tourism and airline companies have already launched online travel fairs. With a typhoon and a long weekend, a wave of travel buying surged this weekend, covering both airfare and themed tour packages.

Lion Travel (2731‑TW) said winter‑season travel orders are up 30% year‑over‑year, helped by stabilising ticket prices and a return of more than 60% of existing members. Travelers now focus more on the purpose of the trip than the destination, with over 70% of Japan‑bound tourists choosing hot springs, food and snow‑country as the three main winter themes.

Lion Travel further observed that short‑haul travelers prefer longer stays. Groups staying six days or more in Japan grew 40%, while Southeast‑Asia travelers shifted toward five‑star hotels and resort‑style vacations. Long‑haul demand rose as international connections and route networks recover and fares stabilise, with European orders up 60%; many booked six months ahead, especially for Northern‑Europe aurora tours and Sydney New Year’s trips.
Lion Travel is optimistic about winter and Chinese‑New‑Year demand, forecasting double‑digit year‑over‑year growth for this round of online travel‑fair sales.

EVA Air (2618‑TW) noted the online fair is underway, offering selected routes at 18% off (pre‑tax). Targeting short‑term flash travelers, it offers Taoyuan‑Hong Kong from NT$3,280, Taoyuan‑Seoul from NT$6,059, Taoyuan‑Okinawa from NT$6,640, and the most popular Japan route, Songshan‑Haneda from NT$11,305. For longer trips, Taoyuan‑Delhi starts at NT$13,940, Taoyuan‑Brisbane at NT$15,334, Taoyuan‑Vienna at NT$22,950, and Taoyuan‑San Francisco at NT$27,000 (tax included).
At the same time, EVA Air will create a lavish physical exhibition themed “Indian Palace” to celebrate the upcoming launch of the Taoyuan‑Delhi route on December 1.

China Airlines (2610‑TW) said the travel fair this year highlights popular routes at a minimum of 24% off (pre‑tax), including Taipei‑Brisbane from NT$15,957, Taipei‑Sydney from NT$16,188, and Taipei‑Melbourne and Taipei‑Auckland both at NT$18,000. Taipei‑Cebu starts at NT$3,354 and Taipei‑Busan at NT$5,994.
China Airlines will increase frequencies on its New Zealand‑Australia routes on October 25, raising Sydney to seven flights per week, Brisbane to six, and Melbourne to five.

items.title: 006208擬分割一拆八！12/18開受益人會議 入手一張只要3萬元
items.title_en: Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208) Plans 1‑for‑8 Split; Beneficiary Meeting on Dec 18, One Unit Costs Only NT$30,000
paras: 台股 ETF 人氣王之一－富邦台 50 ETF(006208-TW)終於走上分割之路，富邦投信將於12月18日以書面方式召開受益人會議，表決是否進行基金分割，初估分割倍數為8倍，藉此降低單位交易價格與投資門檻，屆時買進一張只要 3 萬元，讓小資族更容易入手。若議案順利通過，實際分割倍數將依會議通過當日的基金淨值計算。
富邦投信表示，006208追蹤臺灣50指數，持有台股市值最大的50家上市公司。該基金成立於2012年，初次發行價格為30元，隨台股長期走高，截至2026年10月6日，每單位淨值已達266.74元，市價約265.9元，均為發行價的近9倍，投資門檻也隨之提高，因此規劃透過分割，讓交易價格回到投資人較熟悉的區間，並維持市場流動性。
本次分割倍數並非固定8倍，而是依會議通過當日淨值，以回到30元以上的最大整數倍計算。例如，淨值介於240至269.99元，分割倍數為8倍；若介於270至299.99元，則為9倍。若以8倍分割為例，原持有1單位將調整為8單位，單位淨值則相應降低，基金總價值不會因分割而改變。
投資人可自11月26日起留意開會通知，並選擇書面投票，或透過「集保e手掌握」及各大證券下單App進入集保電子投票平台表決。電子投票期間為11月27日至12月15日，受益憑證過戶則自11月19日至12月18日停止辦理。分割案須有代表已發行受益權單位總數過半數的受益人出席，並經出席者表決權過半數同意，才能通過。
006208人氣與規模同步攀升，截至10月8日受益人數已達71.2萬人；基金規模也從2025年底約2897.8億元，增至今年10月6日的4963億元，今年增加逾2000億元、成長超過七成，距離5000億元大關僅一步之遙。值得注意的是，基金規模突破5000億元後，超過該門檻部分適用的經理費率將降至0.08%。若分割案順利過關，006208可望降低投資人進場門檻，進一步提升交易便利性。

paras_en: One of Taiwan's most popular stock ETFs, the Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208‑TW), is finally moving toward a split. Fubon Asset Management will hold a written beneficiary meeting on December 18 to vote on whether to split the fund, initially estimating an 8‑for‑1 split to lower the unit price and entry threshold. After the split, a single unit could be bought for just NT$30,000, making it easier for retail investors. If the proposal passes, the exact split ratio will be calculated based on the fund's net asset value on the meeting day.

Fubon Asset Management says that 006208 tracks the Taiwan 50 Index, holding the 50 largest listed Taiwanese companies by market cap. The fund was launched in 2012 with an initial price of NT$30 per unit. As the Taiwan market has risen over the long term, the net asset value per unit reached NT$266.74 as of October 6, 2026, with a market price around NT$265.9—nearly nine times the issue price—raising the investment threshold. The split is intended to bring the trading price back to a range familiar to investors while preserving market liquidity.

The split ratio is not fixed at eight; it will be the largest integer multiple that brings the post‑split price back above NT$30, based on the NAV on the meeting day. For example, if the NAV is between NT$240 and NT$269.99, the split will be 8‑for‑1; if it is between NT$270 and NT$299.99, it will be 9‑for‑1. Using an 8‑for‑1 split as an example, one original unit would become eight units, with the unit NAV proportionally reduced, leaving the fund’s total value unchanged.

Investors can start watching for the meeting notice from November 26 and vote in writing, or use the “CDRC e‑Hand” platform and major brokerage apps to access the electronic voting system. The electronic voting period runs from November 27 to December 15, and the transfer of beneficiary certificates is suspended from November 19 to December 18. The split proposal requires attendance by beneficiaries representing more than half of the issued units and approval by a majority of the voting rights present.

The popularity and size of 006208 have both risen. As of October 8, the fund has 712,000 beneficiaries, and its assets under management grew from about NT$289.78 billion at the end of 2025 to NT$496.3 billion on October 6 this year—an increase of over NT$200 billion and more than 70% growth, putting it just shy of the NT$500 billion milestone. Notably, once assets exceed NT$500 billion, the management fee on the excess portion drops to 0.08%. If the split is approved, 006208 could lower entry barriers and further improve trading convenience.
